Package com.javiergs.cortex4j

Class CortexClient

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.cortex4j.CortexClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CortexClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Main entry point for reading EMOTIV Cortex headset streams.

Connect with your registered application credentials, add a CortexListener, and subscribe to a stream. This class manages authorization, headset selection, and the underlying network connection. The first available headset is selected automatically.

For a first experiment, run EMOTIV Launcher, connect a headset (or Virtual Brainwear), and create a cortex4j.properties file on the classpath containing cortex.client.id and cortex.client.secret. Alternatively, set the CORTEX_CLIENT_ID and CORTEX_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. 


 try (CortexClient cortex = CortexClient.connect()) {
   cortex.addListener("met", sample ->
       System.out.println(sample.getValues()));
   cortex.subscribe("met");
   Thread.sleep(30_000);
 }

Supported streams and their availability depend on the headset, Cortex permissions, and EMOTIV licensing. Use try-with-resources to close the active session when finished.

    • addListener

      public void addListener(String stream, CortexListener listener)
      Registers an observer for a stream such as dev, met, eeg, mot, or pow. Register before subscribing.
      Parameters:
      stream - Cortex stream name
      listener - callback invoked for each matching sample
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if stream is blank
      NullPointerException - if listener is null

    • removeListener

      public void removeListener(String stream, CortexListener listener)
      Unregisters a stream observer; this does not unsubscribe the stream.

      listener - previously registered callback

    • subscribe

      public void subscribe(String... streams)
      Subscribes to one or more Cortex data streams.

      Available streams depend on headset and account entitlements.

      Parameters:
      streams - one or more stream names, such as "dev" or "met"
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no streams are provided
      IllegalStateException - if the subscription is rejected or the client is closed

    • unsubscribe

      public void unsubscribe(String... streams)
      Unsubscribes from one or more Cortex streams.
      Parameters:
      streams - one or more stream names to stop
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no streams are provided
      IllegalStateException - if the client is closed or the request fails
